headline: Licensed aircraft engineer, 14 years on regional turboprops
bio: I lead a hangar shift for a regional carrier in Nairobi. I enjoy helping technicians prepare for their licence modules and oral boards, and I am glad to talk through fault-finding on hydraulics and landing gear.

headline: Supply chain manager, formerly a secondary school teacher
bio: I moved from the classroom into warehousing eleven years ago and now run distribution for a consumer goods firm in Mombasa. If you are thinking of switching into this line of work from somewhere else, I can share what the move really involved.

headline: Head of engineering at a power utility
bio: Twenty years in grid operations in Kampala. These days most of my time goes to people: first-time supervisors, difficult conversations, building a team that owns its results. Happy to coach anyone taking on their first team.

headline: Apprentice technician working towards a maintenance licence
bio: Two years into an apprenticeship at an airport workshop. I want to pass my remaining licence modules and would value guidance from someone who has sat the same exams.

headline: Bank teller hoping to move into moving goods for a living
bio: After four years behind a counter I want to work where stock is received, stored and sent out on time. I am not sure how people make that jump or which skills carry over.
